scope: Single admitted publisher Boolean protocol: live buffer implies unresolved durable publisher custody; every revoker requires native lock exclusion AND no durable publisher before acknowledgment. Backend loss changes native lock only, never publication custody. Consumer drain retires custody only after actual final delivery/discard acknowledgment. Safety properties are inductive for modeled transitions. Premises: truthful complete durable registry, authenticated enrollment/retirement, fresh native writer observations, atomic participating writer guard and complete release paths. Does not verify SQL/TS refinement, caller/lease issuer authenticity, native registry implementation, PID/incarnation correspondence, process death recovery, multiple publishers, liveness/fairness or backend acceptance. Current lock-only native component is the unsafe negative control, not this persistent implementation.
